self_audit: Walked every screen state and transition in DESIGN.md (1-225) and EXPERIENCE.md (1-556): first launch before any cycle, first-poll failure, empty versus unknown fleet, partial pages, failed/stale/overrun sources, selected row leaving or being hidden, filters and historical hiding everything, width bands down to below 80 and heights below the 12-row minimum, NO_COLOR and --ascii, key reader unavailable and signals, untrusted long strings and control characters, and every place unknown could read as zero or false. Spot-checked the spec at rendering-rules.md:13,17,19,51 and adapter-contract.md:51 for other_side citations. Step 4 (deletion check) skipped: no diff.

findings.trigger_condition: First launch, before any worker-list poll completes; COUNTS source-count tokens rendered
findings.guard_snippet: if not polled: counts.source = 'source counts: NOT POLLED'; header.scope = 'scope unknown'; status_line = ''
findings.potential_consequence: active/reclaimable/retained/released may render as 0 before any data exists
findings.evidence: PROPOSED: header `as of not yet polled`, COUNTS `collected 0 / reported unknown`, ledger line `waiting for first worker-list poll`.

findings.trigger_condition: Very first poll fails, times out, returns FAILED (shape), or binary missing
findings.guard_snippet: if failed and last_good is None: ledger_body = 'no worker-list data yet: first poll FAILED (<reason>)'; counts = 'collected 0 / reported unknown'
findings.potential_consequence: 'last good rows kept' has nothing to keep; ledger body undefined, possibly blank
findings.evidence: Failed poll | `FAILED (...)` cell; last good rows kept with `as of`; retries back off up to 60 s.

findings.trigger_condition: Source is STALE or FAILED while the header keeps redrawing every cycle
findings.guard_snippet: header.as_of = last_good_poll_local_time or 'not yet polled'  # never render time
findings.potential_consequence: Header 'as of' may show render time, making stale data look current
findings.evidence: UX: `as of <HH:MM:SS>`; spec: `as of <local time of last good poll>`.

findings.trigger_condition: Every collected row is historical (hidden by default) or the filter matches none
findings.guard_snippet: if visible_rows == 0 and collected > 0: ledger_body = f'0 of {collected} collected shown ({hidden} historical hidden, filter: {expr})'
findings.potential_consequence: Ledger body blank or reads like the empty-fleet state; hidden rows look absent
findings.evidence: Historical rows (`terminalState` released or retained) are hidden by default, with `k historical hidden (h)` shown.

findings.trigger_condition: Selected worker becomes historical, or filter or h-toggle hides it, while still in source
findings.guard_snippet: if sel in source and not visible(sel): cursor_row = f'selected {id} hidden by filter/historical'  # not 'no longer in source window'
findings.potential_consequence: Cursor behaviour undefined, or falsely claims the worker left the source window
findings.evidence: If that worker disappears, the cursor row reads `selected <id> no longer in source window` until the user moves.

findings.trigger_condition: User presses Enter, j/k or e on the phantom 'no longer in source window' row, or it reappears
findings.guard_snippet: phantom: Enter -> inspector(last_values, banner='no longer in source window'); j/k -> nearest neighbour by last index; reappear -> restore row
findings.potential_consequence: Undefined target row on move; undefined inspector and export content for vanished worker
findings.evidence: the cursor row reads `selected <id> no longer in source window` until the user moves. The cursor never jumps to another worker.

findings.trigger_condition: Inspector open while source goes STALE/FAILED/PARTIAL or the worker leaves the window
findings.guard_snippet: inspector.top = [freshness_cell, counts_minimum, gap_notice]; if worker_gone: banner('last values as of HH:MM:SS; no longer in source window')
findings.potential_consequence: Full-screen inspector hides never-dropped rows; old values read as current
findings.evidence: A full-screen replacement of the view, not a pane. / The inspector keeps its last values.

findings.trigger_condition: After m, polls fail, go stale, or pages go unread; nothing re-observed
findings.guard_snippet: changed_label = f'changed since {hhmm} ({k}, {u} not reobserved)' if u or stale else f'changed since {hhmm} ({k})'
findings.potential_consequence: 'changed since 14:02 (0)' reads as no change when nothing was observed
findings.evidence: added, removed or changed rows show `*` and are counted in `changed since HH:MM (k)`. ... Rows on unread pages read `not reobserved`.

findings.trigger_condition: User presses m before the first successful poll (no baseline yet)
findings.guard_snippet: if baseline is None: status('mark ignored: no baseline yet') else: mark = now
findings.potential_consequence: Every first-seen row may be marked added; count inflated to all rows
findings.evidence: The first observation in a process is the baseline. ... `m` records a mark in memory only.

findings.trigger_condition: terminalState absent or outside released/retained (vocabulary UNVERIFIED)
findings.guard_snippet: historical = terminalState in {'released','retained'}  # absent/unknown -> shown, never hidden
findings.potential_consequence: Rows with unknown terminalState may be silently hidden as historical
findings.evidence: Historical rows (`terminalState` released or retained) are hidden by default

findings.trigger_condition: A worker record has absent or empty dispatchId
findings.guard_snippet: key = (ns, dispatchId) if dispatchId else ('no-id', page, index); never dedupe rows without an id; show 'dispatchId unknown'
findings.potential_consequence: ID-less rows collapse as duplicates and vanish; selection anchoring impossible
findings.evidence: Selection is anchored to identity (source namespace + `dispatchId`) ... Duplicates are dropped with `k duplicate rows ignored`.

findings.trigger_condition: Two rows share an identity but carry different field values
findings.guard_snippet: keep = max(dups, key=observedAt) if all have observedAt else first_in_source_order
findings.potential_consequence: Which copy is shown and exported is arbitrary between runs
findings.evidence: Duplicates are dropped with `k duplicate rows ignored`.

findings.trigger_condition: Terminal far narrower than 80 columns (for example 30)
findings.guard_snippet: if W < MIN_W: show diagnostic('terminal too narrow: need N cols, have W') wrapping never-cut tokens by cells
findings.potential_consequence: Never-cut tokens and fixed columns cannot satisfy cell_len <= W
findings.evidence: < 80 | short form at the reduced width | `terminal too narrow (min 80)` above the COUNTS strip

findings.trigger_condition: Terminal height below the rows the diagnostic itself needs (about 7)
findings.guard_snippet: if H < diag_rows: render only the diagnostic sentence plus coverage/scope/PARTIAL in one line
findings.potential_consequence: Diagnostic plus never-dropped rows overflow the screen; behaviour undefined
findings.evidence: the too-small diagnostic (screen 3) replaces the ledger. It keeps every row that never drops: the header, freshness, COUNTS, the gap notice and the footer.

findings.trigger_condition: Width below 74 cells; the 74-cell gap notice must be cut or wrapped
findings.guard_snippet: gap_notice wraps by cells; never cut; 'not "no questions"' always rendered
findings.potential_consequence: Cut after '0 rows' reads as zero questions, the forbidden reading
findings.evidence: Gap notice: `Human questions: source UNVERIFIED, 0 rows interpreted, not "no questions"`

findings.trigger_condition: At 80 columns: STALE plus last FAILED plus cycle overran plus messages cell
findings.guard_snippet: freshness strip wraps to 2 lines; state words (STALE/FAILED/NOT POLLED) never cut
findings.potential_consequence: About 100 cells on one line; state word may be cut off
findings.evidence: PROPOSED: `STALE <age>, last poll FAILED (<reason>)` / the strip shows `cycle overran (Ns)`

findings.trigger_condition: PARTIAL at 80 or 116 columns; 118-cell sentence on a one-line status line
findings.guard_snippet: status line wraps by cells, or PARTIAL sentence moves to its own wrapped row; never cut
findings.potential_consequence: Never-truncated sentence cannot fit one line; contradicts cell_len <= W
findings.evidence: `PARTIAL` in the COUNTS strip (never truncated) plus the full partial sentence on the status line.

findings.trigger_condition: POSIX run with stdin/stdout not a TTY, termios failing, or stdin EOF mid-session
findings.guard_snippet: if not (stdin.isatty() and stdout.isatty()): run --once semantics or exit with 'interactive mode needs a TTY'
findings.potential_consequence: Crash, busy loop on EOF, or escape codes written into a pipe
findings.evidence: POSIX terminals run interactively. / Windows supports `--once` only

findings.trigger_condition: Ctrl-Z suspend and fg resume, SIGHUP on terminal close, or a paste burst
findings.guard_snippet: handle SIGTSTP: restore terminal then stop; SIGCONT: re-enter raw mode and full redraw; SIGHUP: restore and exit
findings.potential_consequence: Shell left in raw mode or screen garbled after resume
findings.evidence: The terminal is restored (echo, cursor, alternate screen) on `q`, Ctrl-C, SIGTERM and an unhandled exception.

findings.trigger_condition: Arrow keys, empty Enter, invalid or very long expression in filter input
findings.guard_snippet: filter mode: arrows ignored; empty Enter clears filter; invalid expr -> 'filter invalid: <reason>' keeping previous; expr display cut with '>'
findings.potential_consequence: Undefined filter behaviour; status line overflow from long expression
findings.evidence: Up / Down, `k` / `j` ... | `j`/`k` are typed as text; `Enter` ... apply the filter and return to the ledger

findings.trigger_condition: Resize below minimum while inspector or filter input is open, then back
findings.guard_snippet: diagnostic overlays mode; keep mode stack (inspector/filter text) and restore on resize back
findings.potential_consequence: Filter text or inspector context lost; key handling in diagnostic undefined
findings.evidence: A refresh never moves focus or selection. It never closes the inspector or the filter input

findings.trigger_condition: NO_COLOR set to another non-empty value (for example 0), or empty
findings.guard_snippet: no_color = os.environ.get('NO_COLOR', '') != ''  # any non-empty value; SGR 1/7 still allowed
findings.potential_consequence: Two documents give different triggers; reverse video and bold status undefined
findings.evidence: DESIGN: `NO_COLOR` set to a non-empty value; EXPERIENCE: `NO_COLOR=1` and `NO_COLOR=yes` turn off all SGR colour.

findings.trigger_condition: --ascii with an ID or value containing non-ASCII characters
findings.guard_snippet: ascii mode: escape non-ASCII as \uXXXX in inspector and export instead of '?'
findings.potential_consequence: Full IDs become lossy; distinct IDs look identical; copied commands target wrong worker
findings.evidence: PROPOSED: under `--ascii`, any other non-ASCII character in source text is shown as `?`.

findings.trigger_condition: Non-UTF-8 terminal started without the --ascii flag
findings.guard_snippet: if locale encoding is not UTF-8 and not ascii_flag: enable ascii mode and note 'ascii (auto)' in header
findings.potential_consequence: Box glyphs and cursor render as mojibake or encode errors
findings.evidence: Non-UTF-8 terminals use `--ascii`.

findings.trigger_condition: A source value that fits naturally ends with the character >
findings.guard_snippet: if value fits and endswith('>'): render unchanged but distinguish truncation (e.g. marker only when cut, documented ambiguity)
findings.potential_consequence: Complete value reads as truncated, or vice versa
findings.evidence: List cells cut by display-cell width and end with a visible `>`

findings.trigger_condition: Worker-supplied value contains newline followed by text like 'dispatchId: x'
findings.guard_snippet: inspector/export: indent continuation lines of a value (e.g. '  | ') so no line can start a label
findings.potential_consequence: Spoofed field lines in inspector or export; supervisor copies a fake ID
findings.evidence: bare C0 control characters, except newline in the inspector / Fields are listed one per line, label then value.

findings.trigger_condition: Text contains DEL 0x7F, U+2028/U+2029, or East Asian ambiguous-width characters
findings.guard_snippet: strip 0x7F and categories Zl/Zp; treat ambiguous-width as 2 cells or replace
findings.potential_consequence: Unexpected line breaks or lines exceeding W in some terminals
findings.evidence: C1 control characters; bare C0 control characters ...; Unicode format characters (category Cf).

findings.trigger_condition: stage.detail or sanitized stderr is megabytes long
findings.guard_snippet: inspector: page keys (PgUp/PgDn) plus a display cap with 'N more lines; full value in export'
findings.potential_consequence: Line-by-line scrolling impractical; render time or memory spikes
findings.evidence: Values are wrapped by cells and never truncated. / A failed poll shows its sanitized stderr here.

findings.trigger_condition: Freshness cell is NOT AVAILABLE or 'cycle overran' (implicit states)
findings.guard_snippet: freshness colours: NOT AVAILABLE -> bad or warn; cycle overran -> warn; add both to the state vocabulary
findings.potential_consequence: Colour and vocabulary undefined for two reachable freshness states
findings.evidence: The state word is coloured: OK ink, STALE warn, FAILED bad, NOT POLLED muted, UNVERIFIED warn.

findings.trigger_condition: Start-up view choice happens before any question poll has run
findings.guard_snippet: at start-up: await first question poll with timeout T; choose B only on success; define gap-notice return if it later fails
findings.potential_consequence: B can never be the default, or start-up blocks indefinitely
findings.evidence: The default view is chosen once at start-up ... If the question source has not succeeded in this process, the observer starts on the R1 ledger

findings.trigger_condition: Live poll returns 0 workers with scope unknown, PARTIAL, or source later STALE
findings.guard_snippet: empty line = 'worker-list returned 0 workers in scope=<scope or scope unknown> as of HH:MM:SS; not proof none exist'
findings.potential_consequence: Empty live fleet reads as proof of no workers
findings.evidence: Empty | `worker-list returned 0 workers in scope=<scope>`; fixture: `no observed items in this source window; not proof none exist`

findings.trigger_condition: --once run with no terminal width, or its single poll fails
findings.guard_snippet: --once: use full-table record form regardless of W; exit nonzero when the poll FAILED
findings.potential_consequence: Layout form undefined; scripts treat a failed poll as success
findings.evidence: Text export (`e` in session, or `--once`) ... Writes the same view model as plain text

findings.trigger_condition: Row flagged 'order unknown' or 'conflict (time went back)' at 116 or 80 columns
findings.guard_snippet: flag replaces the age cell in line forms (age cell = 'order?' / 'conflict')
findings.potential_consequence: No cell holds the flag; it is dropped in narrow forms
findings.evidence: A row missing both timestamps is flagged `order unknown`; a backward timestamp shows `conflict (time went back)`

findings.trigger_condition: Enter pressed with no rows, on the loading line, or before any selection exists
findings.guard_snippet: initial selection = first visible row; Enter with no selectable row does nothing
findings.potential_consequence: Inspector opened on nothing; initial cursor position undefined
findings.evidence: `Enter` | open the inspector for the selected row

findings.trigger_condition: Mark spans midnight, age exceeds hours/days, or wall clock jumps
findings.guard_snippet: show date when mark day != today; age format 'Nd Nh' within 7 cells; state local time zone once
findings.potential_consequence: 'changed since 23:58' ambiguous next day; long ages overflow the 7-cell column
findings.evidence: on a monotonic clock / `changed since HH:MM (k)`
